title: The 4 Lights to God’s Will
hook: Stuck on a decision? Follow the 4 lights to God’s will.
script: Stuck on a decision? Follow the 4 lights to God’s will. First, Scripture: does God’s Word support it? Your word is a lamp to my feet (Psalm 119:105). Second, the Spirit’s peace: let Christ’s peace rule, not panic (Colossians 3:15). Third, wise counsel: invite godly voices who know you (Proverbs 11:14). Fourth, providence: notice the doors God opens and closes; don’t force them (Revelation 3:7; Proverbs 16:9). Hold your desire surrendered and delight in the Lord (Psalm 37:4). If a light turns red, wait. If they shine together, step forward with humility. Save this for your next crossroads.

title: 48 Hours to Clarity with God
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. For the next 48 hours, follow the four lights. Day one: quiet the noise, pray, and read Psalm 119, asking, Lord, light my path (119:105). Write your desire, then surrender it: I delight in you; lead my heart (Psalm 37:4). Text a mature believer for counsel (Proverbs 11:14), then sleep. Day two: check your heart—do you sense Christ’s peace, not pressure (Colossians 3:15)? Look for providence—doors opened or shut without striving (Revelation 3:7; Proverbs 16:9). If peace, Word, counsel, and providence agree, decide by sunset and thank God. If not, wait one more step, not one more worry.

title: LAMP: A Simple Way to Know God’s Will
hook: You may be overthinking this—use LAMP to find God’s will.
script: You may be overthinking this—use LAMP to find God’s will. L is Lamp: God’s Word lights the path; if Scripture says no, it’s no (Psalm 119:105). A is Assurance: let Christ’s peace referee your heart, not fear (Colossians 3:15). M is Mentors: ask wise counsel that loves Scripture and your soul (Proverbs 11:14). P is Providence: watch for the door He opens or shuts; don’t pry it with worry (Revelation 3:7; Proverbs 16:9). Surrender your desire while you walk, delighting in Him (Psalm 37:4). Pray, Lord, align my steps with your will. Save this and replay until LAMP sticks.
